title: Göbekli Tepe as an astronomical calendar tracking the Great Year

tellings.quote: because look at the pillars of quec Tepe have they're just basically star constellations

plain: The idea is that Göbekli Tepe, an ancient site of carved stone pillars in Turkey, was built as a sky calendar tracking the Great Year, the very long cycle over which the stars slowly shift their place in the sky. A researcher named Matt LaCroix puts it this way on the show, without naming a source: the pillars "are just basically star constellations." If he is right, the people who raised the site were watching the heavens with great care.
